Title: Unticking one role for dt2\ns000134 leaves the menus and sub menus as expected
Step Action: Open System Administration > Manage Roles and tick every optional role for dt2\ns000134.
Untick the role of the row.
Open Home and each section (System Administration, Manage Contracts, Manage Schemes, Distributions).
Step Expected: Each section menu lists its items, with Invoice Generation under Manage Contracts as in the row.

Step Action: Open the page of the row.
Step Expected: The page opens or shows Access Denied as in the row.

Step Action: Open every sub menu page of the section of the row and of System Administration.
Step Expected: Each page is allowed or denied as in the row; untick the remaining roles afterwards to restore the Admin-only baseline.

Title: Ticking one role for dt2\ns000134 gives access to its menus and sub menus
Step Action: Open Manage Roles; make sure only the Admin role is ticked for dt2\ns000134.
Tick the role of the row.
Open Home and each section.
Step Expected: Each section menu lists its items, with Invoice Generation only for Generate Invoices.

Step Action: Open the page of the row.
Step Expected: The page opens without Access Denied.

Step Action: Open every sub menu page of the section of the row and of System Administration.
Step Expected: Each page opens without Access Denied; untick the role afterwards.

Title: Each tab of a scheme opens without an error
Step Action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes.
Click Details on the first scheme.
Click the tab of the row.
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A pending order opens from Review Pending Orders
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers.
Click Review Pending Orders.
Click Details on the first order.
Step Expected: The pending order page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Check the address.
Step Expected: The page is PendingContractOrder.aspx with no server error.

Title: Import Permit opens from a contract and Cancel returns to the contract list
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and click Contracts on the first customer.
Click Import Permit(s).
Check the buttons.
Click Cancel.
Check the address.
Step Expected: The page is ContractList.aspx with no server error.

Title: A field of an external test consultant is edited and kept
Step Action: Open System Administration > Manage External Test Consultants.
Add a consultant with a unique name and click Save.
Click Edit on the consultant and change the field of the row to the value of the row.
Step Expected: The edit boxes show the value.

Step Action: Click the row Save link and the page Save button.
Find the consultant in the list.
Step Expected: The row shows the new value; the test removes the consultant afterwards.
